history.body: Hi, we saw the Pearl Residences ad. We’re renting a small place and looking for our first home with our young child. The three-bedroom layout caught our eye—do you have a show unit we could walk through?

A walk-through would help you see whether the 900 sq. ft., three-bedroom, two-bathroom layout feels right for your family. I can’t confirm show-unit availability from the information I have. Would you like a salesperson to check and contact you to arrange a visit if one is available?
Yes, please ask them to check if there’s a show unit and contact us. Seeing how the rooms feel in person would help us decide.

Absolutely—I’ll ask a salesperson to check whether a show unit is available and contact you to arrange a walk-through if possible. Seeing the rooms and living space in person should help you judge how the layout feels for your family.
